why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Ben Rice is slot #3 (4.763 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #4, #5, #6, #7, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.008 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.49 expected PA/game vs 4.59 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
